MATCH (spouse:Character)-[:hasSpouse]->(lady:Character)
WHERE lady.name = 'Lady Liu'
WITH killers, collect(DISTINCT spouse.name) AS spouses
RETURN size(apoc.coll.union(killers, spouses)) AS count"
  ,"rationale": "The query finds characters who killed Liu Fu via the killedBy relationship (where the killer is the source and Liu Fu is the target), and characters married to Lady Liu via hasSpouse. It collects their names and returns the size of the union to count distinct characters satisfying either condition."
}
